what: the Record's held-out check of every place side by side, each read from that place's own calendar (harmonization_method.validation): for each overlap year but a closed one, the served method is fitted on the other years and that year's Suomi NPP count is predicted from its MODIS count
definition: for each overlap year but a closed one: the method is fitted on the other overlap years and predicts that year's Suomi NPP count of every clean month from its MODIS count; relative error = (predicted - observed) / observed over the year; coverage = share of held-out years (annual) or months (monthly) whose observed Suomi NPP count lies inside the interval
nominal_interval: 80 percent: the 10th to 90th percentile of held-out errors of predictions of about the same size, per latitude band
